features/pm-jira-4804.toon.body:
Deepen pm-jira to domain-appropriate maximum against SDK 2026.5.31.

VALUE: pm-jira already had jira sync/import/export + schema fields + status-map (commit dbf38cf). This feature closes the remaining real gaps from the enhancement brief.

OUTCOME: idempotent re-import (update existing pm items matched on Jira key instead of duplicating; persist jira_key/jira_url), a real credential+reachability preflight surfaced as the 'preflight' capability, rate-limit/backoff robustness, and an --assignee filter. Manifest capabilities corrected to match what is actually registered (drop unregistered 'services' filler; add 'preflight').

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- pm jira import re-run updates matched items (no duplicates), keyed on Jira key provenance + jira_key field.
- jira_key/jira_url persisted onto items (via pm update --field or description marker fallback).
- pm jira preflight validates creds + base URL + reachability with clear failure_hints; registerPreflight guard registered.
- 429/503 responses retried with exponential backoff + Retry-After honoring.
- --assignee filter augments default JQL.
- manifest capabilities == registered surfaces exactly.
- typecheck/build/test/changelog:check/release:check all green; new unit tests for idempotency match + backoff parse + preflight.
- Functionally tested in --dry-run against scratch workspace with fixture JSON.

features/pm-jira-i7fd.toon.body:
Enhance pm-jira per the 2026-06-03 release-engineer brief, scoped to offline-testable value since no live Jira creds are available.

Delivered:
1. JQL builder (buildJql) + convenience filters --project/--status/--assignee/--issue-type/--label/--updated-since composing into a single quoted JQL; --jql still verbatim. Pure + unit-tested.
2. --dry-run on BOTH import and export. Import prints JQL + exact GET request and makes ZERO network calls. Export prints the would-be POST/PUT Jira mutations from real pm items, no creds/network.
3. Field-mapping depth: statusCategory fallback, issuetype->pm type, assignee->tag, reverse priority/type maps for export, plus --map jiraField=pmField overrides. Pure + unit-tested.
4. export-on-write hook (opt-in via PM_JIRA_PUSH_ON_WRITE, best-effort no-op without creds). Added 'hooks' capability (verified active: hook_counts write:1).
5. pm jira validate diagnostics: reports cred/base-url readiness without leaking secrets (hostname-only preview), --json returns the object.
6. Manifest capability correctness: dropped phantom 'services' (never registered; #96 risk), added 'hooks'. registerExporter is gated by 'importers' (exporters is NOT a valid token).

NEEDS LIVE CREDS (could not exercise): actual JQL fetch, real issue POST/PUT on --push, live reachability. All logic feeding them is dry-run/unit verified.

features/pm-jira-xfd9.toon.body: Hands-on functional test pass with real CLI invocation and stubbed Jira API. Found and fixed 3 real bugs of the known classes (option normalization, exit codes, field mapping). See child Issues.

issues/pm-jira-1aqg.toon.body:
SYMPTOM: synced pm items had no body and no priority. The Jira API response includes description (Atlassian Document Format) and priority, and the code even defined adfToPlainText() and mapJiraPriority() — but both were DEAD CODE; the pm create spawn passed only --title/--status/--type/--tags. Real-world data (long descriptions, priorities, due dates) was silently dropped.

REPRO: sync any project; inspect created item -> body empty, priority defaulted.

OBSERVED vs EXPECTED: observed body/priority/deadline missing; expected mapped from Jira.

FIX: write path (command + importer) now passes --priority (mapJiraPriority), --body (adfToPlainText of description) when present, and --deadline from fields.duedate. Missing optional fields handled (priority defaults to 3; body/deadline/tags omitted when absent). Verified via stubbed-network + real pm create: stored item has priority:2, body:DESC-BODY-MARKER, deadline:2026-06-15, tags:lbl1,v9.

issues/pm-jira-dhsn.toon.body:
SYMPTOM: `pm jira sync --project PROJ --dry-run` does NOT preview — it executes the write path and creates pm items. Same for --max-results being ignored (always 500).

REPRO: pm jira sync --project PROJ --dry-run (with valid creds). Items get created despite dry-run.

ROOT CAUSE: pm CLI normalizes loose extension flags to camelCase (extension-command-options.js toLooseOptionKey: --dry-run -> dryRun, --max-results -> maxResults). Code read ctx.options['dry-run'] / ['max-results'] (kebab) which are always undefined -> dryRun=false -> write path taken. Proven: probe showed ctx.options['dry-run']=undefined, ctx.options['dryRun']=true.

OBSERVED vs EXPECTED: observed = silent writes during 'preview'; expected = no writes, preview only.

FIX: added readStringOption/readNumberOption/readBooleanOption helpers that check BOTH kebab and camelCase keys; applied to project/jql/max-results/dry-run/status in both command and importer. Verified via stubbed-network probe: dry-run now makes 0 pm create calls and returns dryRun:true.

issues/pm-jira-lk24.toon.body:
SYMPTOM: missing credentials, missing --project/--jql, and Jira fetch failures all returned { success:false, error } from run(), which the CLI treats as a successful command -> exit code 0. A CI/script chaining on exit status proceeds as if the sync succeeded.

REPRO: unset JIRA_BASE_URL JIRA_API_TOKEN JIRA_EMAIL; pm jira sync --project PROJ >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $? -> 0 (before fix).

OBSERVED vs EXPECTED: observed exit 0 on failure; expected non-zero.

FIX: replaced the three `return { success:false, ... }` paths with `throw new Error(...)`. Verified live after fix: no-creds=1, no-project=1, fetch-failure=1.

tasks/pm-jira-49oh.toon.body: Verified offline: JQL build, dry-run GET/plan, field mapping both ways, --map, validate, missing-creds CommandError, hook no-op. NOT exercisable without creds: live JQL search fetch + paging, real issue create POST (--push), real update PUT, live reachability check. All code feeding these paths is unit- and dry-run-verified; only the network round-trip is unproven.

tasks/pm-jira-4dfb.toon.body: diagnoseCreds reports ready/present booleans + baseUrlSource + hostname-only redacted preview; never echoes token/email. Command returns the object (global --json renders; no stdout corruption). Verified: NOT READY with no creds (exit 0), redaction to hostname with --host.

tasks/pm-jira-4r5q.toon.body: Import dry-run builds+prints the exact GET via buildSearchRequest and returns {jql,request}; makes NO Jira call. Export dry-run builds buildExportPlan (create vs update by provenance) and prints would-be POST/PUT, no creds/network. strace proof: bogus JIRA_BASE_URL never resolved; only connect is pm-cli's own baseline 443 (identical on plain 'pm list').

tasks/pm-jira-5d71.toon.body: Implemented release-ready package metadata and automation for pm-jira using the latest pm CLI 2026.5.24 and pm SDK contracts. Added local pm project tracking, CI/release workflows, pm-changelog integration, TypeScript checks, production audit gates, dry-run packaging, installability metadata, and registry metadata. Verified no private tokens or personal files are present in tracked files or reachable git history before release preparation.

tasks/pm-jira-65ao.toon.body: api.hooks.onWrite gated by decidePushOnWrite (pure): acts only when PM_JIRA_PUSH_ON_WRITE truthy AND project-scoped create/update (ignores :history, delete, non-project). No-op without creds; hook runtime swallows throws. Verified active (hook_counts write:1) and that pm create still exits 0 with hook enabled and no creds. Live upstream PUT intentionally left to explicit 'export --push' so a stray write never spams Jira.

tasks/pm-jira-7bmf.toon.body: mapJiraStatusCategory fallback, mapJiraIssueType, assignee->tag, reverse mapPmPriorityToJira/mapPmTypeToJira (export --rich), parseFieldMap with validation. issueToItem stays back-compat (bare statusMap 3rd arg still accepted). Unit-tested both directions.

tasks/pm-jira-7y1y.toon.body: Jira->pm: status by NAME first, falling back to statusCategory bucket (new/indeterminate/done) so custom workflows resolve; --map status=/statuscategory= pins. issuetype->pm type heuristic (Bug/Story=Feature/Epic=Feature/Task) with --map type=/issuetype= override. assignee->'assignee:<name>' tag (no dedicated pm field; --map assignee=skip opts out; #97 means no custom-field setter). priority via existing name heuristic. Export reverse maps priority+issuetype only under --rich to keep the historical 'always Task, no priority' shape as default.

tasks/pm-jira-h5wu.toon.body: onWrite is registered always (so 'hooks' capability is genuinely used) but is a strict no-op unless PM_JIRA_PUSH_ON_WRITE is truthy AND creds present. Even when enabled it does NOT auto-POST to Jira: the onWrite ctx only yields {path,scope,op} (no item body), and auto-pushing every write risks spamming/duplicating upstream issues. Real upstream sync stays the explicit, reviewable 'pm jira export --push'. Hook is the opt-in, testable surface; logic isolated in pure decidePushOnWrite.

tasks/pm-jira-ko1c.toon.body: buildJql() composes filters into one ordered, value-quoted JQL; readJqlFilters reads kebab+camel. Date values force-quoted (Jira parses bare -7d as arithmetic). Wired into runImport + jira-sync importer. Unit tests cover verbatim --jql, defaults, composition, status->statusCategory, quoting/escaping. Functionally verified via dry-run.

tasks/pm-jira-wsn0.toon.body: Dropped phantom 'services' (never registered; per #96 a service override would corrupt output), added 'hooks'. Confirmed via SDK loader that registerExporter is gated by 'importers' and 'exporters' is not a valid token. Install shows capabilities=[commands,hooks,importers,schema]. README updated.

tasks/pm-jira-yhm3.toon.body: Wire the existing PUT helper into export --push behind a new opt-in --update-existing flag: provenance-matched items are PUT to /rest/api/3/issue/<KEY> (project field stripped) instead of being skipped. Add per-page 'Fetched N/total...' import progress to STDERR. Add a STDERR transparency note when fetched issues carry attachments/comments that are not imported. All additive, offline-testable via --dry-run.
